body:

  • The reason you were temp-banned/banned
  • Why you should be unbanned from the server.
  • IGN- Athune
  • Ban Evasion by SeeUSoon
  • I fucked up, this is no ordinary fuck up, I messed up BIG time. I got banned for Ban Evasion by the staff member SeeUSoon and I got annoyed a bit about it I keep on being banned for that same reason just because my brother got banned on here with my IP. I have no words to say but I am ashamed to be the person I am I shit talked staff members I honestly regret it all I don't like being this person and I would like one last and final chance. I got so mad about my ban because the same reason pops up so frequently that I was retarded enough to hack on here, I was a founder of a well known hacking clan on here called "Cuckle" it was me and a few others i'll tell you igns if needed. I am here begging to bounce off this reflection and reflect something in a better manner not inappropriate like hacking on a minecraft server! honestly it leads me no where and I'm so ashamed in myself in my wrong doings. I hope you take this into consideration I will never go on alts and never cheat on your server again I just want a unban please.
